q1_issues.issue: "for the coming month" names the period the ration covers, not when the issuing happened, so (Time sk_issue_2 next_month) places a Past event in a future month.

Same misplacement on the second issuing — (Time sk_issue_3 next_month) contradicts (Past sk_issue_3) — and the narrative-relative "the coming month" is rendered as the speech-anchored deictic constant next_month rather than resolved against the discourse time.
The superlative in "the two stations nearest the Sunken Cove" is dropped: (Near sk_stations_1 sunken_cove) says only that the stations are near the cove, which widens the restriction the text states.

q2_gaps: superlative with a comparison landmark ("the two stations nearest the Sunken Cove") — Most / AmongMost take a comparison-CLASS slot and have no slot for the entity compared against, so a landmark superlative has no licensed form

a coverage-period / temporal-extent "for <time span>" adjunct on an event ("issued ... for the coming month") — Beneficiary is benefit-only, Time asserts the event's own time, and no head is designated for the period an action's effect covers

measure-of NP ("fourteen weeks of winter supply", "eight weeks of supply") — Possessive / genitive NP explicitly excludes a measure of-phrase ("a cup of water") but no positive encoding is supplied in its place

additive-quantity modifier "extra" ("extra ground feathers") — not a fusing classifier and not one of the excessive / insufficient / sufficient quantity markers, so the descriptive-modifier route ends up asserting of each individual feather that it is `extra`
